title: Blueberry Oat Crisp
description: Sweet Florida blueberries topped with a buttery oat crumble for a simple dessert that's not overly sweet.
instructions: Toss blueberries with lemon juice and honey. Place in a baking dish.
Mix oats, flour, pecans, cinnamon, and butter until crumbly.
Bake for 35 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Fresh Florida blueberries are best when in season.
Serve with plain Greek yogurt or a small scoop of vanilla ice cream for a special treat.
leftovers: Keeps well and is delicious cold or warmed.
whyWeChoseThis: Not overly sweet, so it works any night of the week.
A buttery oat topping instead of a heavy crust.
A good way to use fresh blueberries in season.
